sql: select (select count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '15 minutes') as cands_15m, (select count(*) from paper_trades where created_at > now() - interval '15 minutes') as paper_15m, (select count(*) from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at > now() - interval '15 minutes') as mmsell10_15m, (select count(*) from experiment_deployment_arms eda join experiment_deployments ed on ed.id=eda.deployment_id where eda.strategy_tag='mmsell10' and ed.ended_at is null) as active_arms_for_mmsell10, (select max(started_at)::text from bot_runs) as last_boot, now()::text as now_utc
